frontMatter.about:
stablished in 1988, Bedmutha Industries Limited has evolved into a prominent manufacturer and exporter of high-quality steel wires, wire ropes, and copper products. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and innovation has cemented our reputation in both domestic and international markets.
With a robust supply chain spanning 21 countries across Southeast Asia, Europe, Africa, America, and Australia, we proudly serve diverse industries, including power corporations, defence, railways, infrastructure companies, and automobile manufacturers. Our esteemed brands, "SURE" and "COMMANDO," have become synonymous with quality and trust within the Indian market.
Our dedication to quality is reflected in our certifications from TÜV Nord, ISO: 9001, and ISO: 45001, adhering to both international and Indian statutory norms. By continually integrating advanced technological advancements and eco-conscious practices, we strive to meet the evolving needs of our customers, contributing to sustainable development and a better future for all.
At Bedmutha Industries, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of innovation, delivering solutions that embody technical excellence and align with our vision of global leadership in the steel wire and rope industry.

chapters.title: Emergency Preparedness and Response
chapters.text:
Comprehensive emergency plans are in place for events such as fires, chemical spills, and medical emergencies.
## Fire and Emergency Procedures
- Know your nearest emergency exit, fire extinguisher, and assembly point.
- Participate in scheduled fire drills (minimum twice per year).
- Emergency response teams are trained in evacuation and first aid protocols.
## First Aid and Medical Assistance
- First aid kits are accessible across all workstations and communal areas.
- Certified first responders are stationed at each facility.
- In case of medical emergencies, contact the nearest responder or emergency services immediately.
## Safe Handling of Hazardous Substances
- All hazardous substances must be clearly labeled and stored safely.
- Use specialized PPE (e.g., chemical-resistant gloves, respirators) when necessary.
- Ensure proper ventilation and exhaust systems are functional in exposure-prone areas.
- Receive training on handling, spill response, and disposal of hazardous materials.
- Conduct routine air and surface quality monitoring and maintain updated SDS records.
## Occupational Noise Reduction Strategies
- Identify and label high-noise areas using noise level assessments.
- Provide and enforce the use of hearing protection (earplugs, earmuffs).
- Implement engineering controls like noise dampening and enclosures.
- Use employee rotation to minimize prolonged exposure.
- Conduct regular audiometric testing and implement hearing conservation programs.
- Ensure compliance with legal noise exposure thresholds.
## Compliance with Laws and Regulations
Bedmutha Industries adheres strictly to national and international safety and environmental laws, including:
- The Factories Act, 1948 (India)
- Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
- Environmental Protection Act, 1986
## nternal Audits and Inspections
- Regular safety audits will be performed to ensure compliance.
- Non-compliance findings will trigger immediate corrective actions.
- Employees will be kept informed of any regulatory or procedural changes.
## Disciplinary Actions for Non-Compliance
Failure to follow health and safety protocols may result in:
- Verbal or written warnings
- Temporary suspension from duties
- Termination in cases of gross negligence or repeated violations
- Legal action if the breach causes harm or regulatory infringement
## Continuous Improvement and Safety Culture
- Employees are encouraged to suggest safety improvements and raise concerns.
- Regular meetings and feedback sessions will be held to evaluate safety performance.
- Management will adopt evolving industry best practices to enhance health and safety standards.
## Mindfulness and Stress Reduction Techniques
Mental health is a critical component of overall workplace well-being. Bedmutha Industries integrates mindfulness and emotional wellness into its organizational culture to help employees manage stress and improve mental resilience.
## nitiatives Include:
- Wellness Programs: Regular sessions for yoga, meditation, and stress-relief practices.
- Mental Health Support: Access to confidential counseling through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
- Workshops: Focused on emotional resilience, work-life balance, and burnout prevention.
- Break Reminders: Employees are encouraged to take short, regular breaks to maintain focus and reduce fatigue.
- Supportive Leadership: Supervisors are trained to identify signs of stress and guide employees toward available resources.
## Contact Information
For safety concerns, mental health support, or reporting any violations, please contact:
- 📌 Health & Safety Officer: +91 9373009305
- 📌 Human Resources Department: +91 9372622435
- 📌 Emergency Helpline: +91 7038902713
## Employment and Hiring Procedure
At Bedmutha Industries Limited, we are committed to fostering a fair, inclusive, and transparent hiring process. Our employment policies ensure equal opportunities for all candidates while upholding ethical hiring standards. We aim to attract, retain, and develop a skilled workforce aligned with our company’s vision and values.

chapters.title: Recruitment and Selection Process
chapters.text:
## Job Posting and Applications
- All job vacancies are publicly advertised through our official website, job portals, and other communication channels.
- Candidates can apply through our online application system or submit resumes to the HR department.
## Screening and Selection
- Applications are reviewed based on qualifications, skills, and experience relevant to the job role.
- The selection process includes initial screening, interviews, and skill-based assessments.
- Background verification and reference checks are conducted for shortlisted candidates.
## Age Verification and Young Worker Protection
- Strict age verification measures ensure compliance with labor laws.
- We hire only individuals who are 18 years or older to comply with legal and ethical labor standards.
- To verify the age of employees, we require government-issued identification documents such as birth certificates, passports, Aadhaar cards (for India), or national identity cards.
- Young workers, if employed, receive additional protections, including appropriate working hours and supervision.
## Equal Opportunity and Non-Discrimination
- Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, and experience, without discrimination based on gender, age, race, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
- Affirmative action programs promote diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
## Employment Categories and Terms
## Types of Employment
- Permanent Employees: Full-time employees with long-term contracts.
- Contractual Employees: Hired for a fixed duration based on project needs.
- Interns/Trainees: Short-term positions for skill development and experience.
## Employment Agreement
- All employees receive a formal employment contract detailing job role, responsibilities, compensation, benefits, and company policies.
- The agreement outlines terms of employment, including probation periods, termination clauses, and confidentiality obligations.
## Onboarding and Orientation
- A structured induction program introduces new hires to company policies, workplace culture, and safety protocols.
- New employees receive training on ethical practices, compliance standards, and professional development opportunities.
## nternal Mobility and Career Growth
- Career Advancement Opportunities: Employees are encouraged to pursue growth through promotions, lateral moves, and cross-functional roles that match their skills and interests.
- Transparent Internal Job Postings: All internal vacancies are posted on the company’s internal portal, ensuring fair and equal access to opportunities for all eligible employees.
- Eligibility Criteria: Employees must typically complete at least 12 months in their current role and meet the qualifications for the new position.
- Skill Development Support: Training programs, mentorship, and learning resources are available to help employees prepare for future roles.
- Career Guidance: Managers and HR provide support through career discussions and individual development planning.
- Recognition of Potential: Performance, potential, and willingness to grow are key factors in internal hiring decisions, not just tenure.
- Retention and Engagement: Internal mobility fosters job satisfaction, builds loyalty, and helps retain top talent by supporting long-term career growth within the organization.
## Employee Identification Documents
- The company does not retain original identification documents of employees.
- Copies of necessary documents (e.g., PAN card, Aadhaar, educational certificates) are maintained securely for HR records.
## Compliance and Ethical Hiring
- All recruitment activities adhere to labor laws, company ethics, and corporate social responsibility guidelines.
- Recruitment agencies and third-party hiring firms engaged by the company follow the same ethical hiring standards.
At Bedmutha Industries Limited, we strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and growth-oriented work environment where talent is recognized, and opportunities are accessible to all.

chapters.title: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Initiatives
chapters.text:
## Promotion and Career Progression Framework
Our company follows a structured and transparent promotion process to ensure fair and merit-based career advancement for all employees.
## Eligibility Criteria
- Employees must meet the minimum tenure required for promotion.
- Performance benchmarks, skills, and contributions to the company’s goals are key factors in promotion consideration.

chapters.title: Performance Evaluation
chapters.text:
- Employees’ performance is assessed based on predefined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
- 360-degree feedback from peers, subordinates, and managers may be incorporated for leadership roles.
## Skills & Competency Assessment
- Candidates must demonstrate the necessary competencies, technical expertise, and leadership skills for the next role.
- Additional training or certifications may be required to qualify for promotion.
## Application & Nomination Process
- Employees may apply for a promotion or be nominated by their managers based on performance and skillset.
- HR ensures that all eligible employees are aware of promotion opportunities.
## Promotion Review Committee
- A panel comprising HR representatives and senior management reviews applications objectively.
- Decisions are based strictly on merit, performance, and organizational needs to prevent bias.
## Approval & Announcement
- Once finalized, HR communicates the decision to successful candidates.
- Employees not selected receive feedback and guidance for future career progression.
- This structured process ensures a fair, transparent, and merit-driven approach to career growth within the organization.
## Prevention & Monitoring of Workplace Harassment
Beyond grievance mechanisms and training, our company has measures in place to actively prevent and monitor workplace harassment:
- Anonymous Surveys & Feedback Mechanisms: Employees can report concerns anonymously.
- Regular Workplace Audits: Evaluating workplace culture and identifying risk areas.
- Harassment Prevention Task Force: A dedicated team ensuring adherence to anti-harassment policies.
## Ensuring Wage Equality in the Workplace
At Bedmutha Industries Limited, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices to eliminate wage disparities and promote equal pay for all employees.
- Regular Pay Audits: Conduct periodic wage assessments to identify and address any pay disparities based on gender, experience, or job role.
- Standardized Salary Structure: Implement clear salary bands based on job roles, responsibilities, and performance to prevent bias.
- Equal Pay for Equal Work: Ensure employees performing similar roles receive fair and consistent compensation, regardless of gender, age, or background.
- Transparent Salary Policies: Maintain clarity in pay structures and promotion criteria to enhance trust and accountability.
- Bias-Free Performance Evaluations: Train managers to conduct objective assessments, ensuring pay raises and promotions are based on merit.
## Development Opportunities for Women
To support female employees in career growth, we have implemented:
- Mentorship & Sponsorship Programs: Senior leaders mentor women to support career advancement.
- Leadership Training for Women: Programs designed to build leadership skills among female employees.
- Networking Opportunities: Internal and external forums for women to connect and learn from industry leaders.
## Affinity and Support Groups for Minorities and Vulnerable Groups
At Bedmutha Industries Limited, we recognize the importance of creating an inclusive and supportive work environment for all employees. To promote a culture of belonging, respect, and equality, the company supports the formation of Affinity and Support Groups for employees from minority communities and other vulnerable groups.
These groups play a key role in strengthening employee engagement, encouraging open dialogue, and fostering personal and professional development.
## Purpose and Objectives
- Support and Empowerment: Provide a safe space for employees to connect, share experiences, and access peer support.
- Inclusion and Awareness: Promote awareness and understanding of challenges faced by underrepresented groups.
- Professional Growth: Facilitate opportunities for mentorship, leadership development, and skill-building.
- Employee Engagement: Encourage participation in meaningful discussions and initiatives that contribute to company culture.
- Policy Feedback: Serve as a consultative body to HR and management on matters affecting their communities.
## Who Can Participate
- Affinity groups are voluntary and open to all employees, including those who identify as allies.
- Participation is encouraged during designated times approved by management and HR.
## Examples of Affinity and Support Groups
- Women in Leadership
- LGBTQ+ and Allies Network
- Cultural and Ethnic Diversity Group
- Persons with Disabilities Support Group
- Mental Health and Wellbeing Circle
- Working Parents and Caregivers Group
## Formation and Governance
- Employees interested in forming a new group must submit a proposal to the HR Department, outlining the group’s purpose, scope, and membership goals.
- Each group must operate in alignment with the company’s values, Code of Conduct, and Diversity & Inclusion Policy.
- Groups will be supported by HR and may have an executive sponsor to guide their initiatives and align them with organizational goals.

chapters.title: Standard and Flexible Working Hours
chapters.text:
## Standard Working Hours
- The standard working hours are 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, with a one-hour lunch break.
- Employees are required to complete 48 hours per week as per labor regulations.
- Attendance is tracked through the company's biometric system or other digital tracking methods.
Recognizing the diverse needs of employees, Bedmutha Industries offers flexible work arrangements, subject to approval by management:
- Remote Work: Employees in eligible roles can work remotely based on prior agreement with their manager.
- Flexi-Time: Employees can adjust their start and end times while ensuring core working hours are met.
- Hybrid Work Model: A combination of on-site and remote work may be available based on job requirements.
## Attendance and Overtime guidelines
## Attendance Requirements
- Employees must adhere to scheduled work hours and maintain regular attendance.
- Any planned absences should be communicated to the reporting manager in advance.
## Compensation for Extra or Atypical Working Hours
- Employees working beyond standard hours are eligible for overtime pay or compensatory leave, as per company guidelines and labor laws.
- Overtime will be compensated at 1.5 times the regular hourly wage, in accordance with statutory provisions.
- For roles requiring night shifts or atypical working hours, additional allowances may be provided as per company .

chapters.title: Leave Policies
chapters.text:
## Types of Leave Available
- Annual Leave: Employees are entitled to 21 days of paid annual leave per year.
- Sick Leave: Employees can avail up to 12 days of paid medical leave per year by providing necessary documentation.
- Casual Leave: Employees are granted 6 days of casual leave per year for personal reasons, subject to manager approval.
- Maternity Leave: Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave, as per labor laws.
- Paternity Leave: Male employees are entitled to 10 days of paid paternity leave.
- Bereavement Leave: Employees can avail 5 days of leave in case of the loss of an immediate family member.
- Special Leave: Any other leave category (e.g., sabbatical, study leave) is subject to management approval and will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
At Bedmutha Industries Limited, we believe that a supportive workplace enables employees to perform at their best while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. These policies are designed to promote fairness, productivity, and well-being for all employees.
## Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
- Broad Employee Participation – Stock ownership opportunities are available to employees beyond executives and directors.
- Equity Distribution – Employees receive company shares through grants, purchase options, or profit-sharing mechanisms.
- Financial Growth – Employees benefit from dividends, stock appreciation, and long-term wealth creation.
- Retention & Engagement – Encourages employee commitment and aligns interests with company performance.

## Compensation & Benefits
At Bedmutha Industries, we are committed to providing fair compensation, competitive benefits, and financial security for our employees. This section outlines the salary structure, performance rewards, and various employee welfare benefits.
## Salary Structure & Payroll Guidelines
- Employees will receive a salary based on their designation, experience, and industry benchmarks.
- Salaries are structured as follows:
- Basic Salary – Fixed component based on the employee’s role.
- Allowances – Includes House Rent Allowance (HRA), Travel Allowance (TA), and Special Allowance.
- Deductions – Includes Provident Fund (PF), Professional Tax (PT), and Income Tax as per government regulations.
- Salary is credited directly to employees' bank accounts on or before the Xth of every month.
- Salary slips will be provided via email or accessible through the company’s HR portal.
## Bonus, Incentives & Performance-Based Rewards
- Employees may be eligible for performance-based bonuses depending on their individual and team achievements.
- The company provides annual bonuses based on financial performance and contribution to organizational goals.
- Employees in sales, production, or target-based roles may receive incentives based on predefined key performance indicators (KPIs).
- We can provide bonus or apprisal to employee regarding to company performance well in their growth addininal bonus or apprisal to employee.
- Special recognition awards, including “Employee of the Month” and long-term service awards, are given to outstanding employees.
## Health Insurance & Employee Welfare Benefits
- The company provides Group Health Insurance covering hospitalization, medical expenses, and emergency treatments.
- Coverage is extended to the employee and, in some cases, their spouse, children, and dependent parents.
- Accidental insurance and disability benefits are available to employees in case of work-related injuries.
- Additional welfare benefits include:
- Subsidized canteen services
- Employee wellness programs
- Financial assistance in case of emergencies
## Retirement Benefits & Pension Plan
- The company ensures employees’ financial security post-retirement through:
- Employee Pension Scheme (EPS) – A part of the Provident Fund contribution is allocated towards EPS.
- Voluntary Retirement Scheme (VRS) – Eligible employees may opt for early retirement benefits.
- Employees are encouraged to participate in additional investment and savings schemes provided by government or private financial institutions.

chapters.title: Expense Reimbursement Guidelines
chapters.text:

At Bedmutha Industries, we believe that a motivated and engaged workforce is key to organizational success. We are committed to supporting employees’ well-being, fostering a positive work environment, and recognizing their contributions through various engagement initiatives.

chapters.title: Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
chapters.text:

- Areas covered under EAP include:

- Financial planning and debt counselling
- Legal advisory services

## Wellness & Mental Health Support
- Bedmutha Industries prioritizes employee physical and mental well-being by offering:

- Yoga, meditation, and fitness programs to promote holistic well-being.
- Access to mental health professionals for counselling and stress management.

## Employee Recreational & Cultural Activities

## Employee Recognition & Reward Programs
- Bedmutha Industries values employee contributions and celebrates achievements through structured reward programs.
- Recognition programs include:
- “Employee of the Month” & “Star Performer” Awards for exceptional contributions.
- Long-Service Awards for employees who complete significant tenure milestones (5, 10, 15+ years).
- Performance-based Incentives for outstanding work beyond expectations.
- Peer-to-Peer Recognition where employees can nominate colleagues for their contributions.
- Employees are encouraged to recognize and appreciate their peers, fostering a positive and motivated work environment.
## Employee’s Provident Fund & Employee’s Pension Scheme
The Employee’s Provident Fund (EPF) is a government-mandated retirement savings scheme aimed at ensuring financial security for employees after their working years. At Bedmutha Industries, we are committed to complying with EPF regulations to support employees in building long-term financial stability.
## Eligibility
- All employees earning a basic salary of ₹15,000 or less per month are mandatorily covered under EPF.
- Employees with salaries above ₹15,000 per month may choose to opt-in voluntarily.
- Contributions to the EPF start from the date of joining the organization.
## EPF Contribution Structure
- Employer Contribution: 12% of basic salary + Dearness Allowance (DA) goes towards EPF.
- Employee Contribution: 12% of basic salary + DA is deducted from the employee’s salary and deposited into their EPF account.
- Breakdown of Contributions:
## Employer’s 12% contribution:
- 3.67% goes to the Employee Provident Fund (EPF).
- 8.33% is allocated to the Employee’s Pension Scheme (EPS).
## Employee’s 12% contribution:
- The entire amount is deposited in the EPF account.
## EPF Benefits
- Tax-Free Savings: EPF contributions and interest earned are tax-exempt under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act.
- Withdrawal Facility:
- Full withdrawal is allowed after retirement (age 58) or if unemployed for more than 2 months.
- Partial withdrawals are permitted for medical expenses, home loans, higher education, or marriage.
- Nomination & Beneficiary Benefits: Employees can nominate a family member to receive the EPF funds in case of unforeseen events.
## EPF Account Access & UAN
- Each employee is provided with a Universal Account Number (UAN), which remains the same across multiple employers.
- Employees can track their EPF balance and manage withdrawals through the EPFO Member Portal or UMANG mobile app.

chapters.title: Gratuity
chapters.text:
The Gratuity Act, 1972, mandates that employees receive gratuity as a lump sum payment upon completion of service with the company. Gratuity is a reward for long-term service and loyalty to Bedmutha Industries.
## Eligibility
- Employees must have completed 5 years of continuous service at Bedmutha Industries.
- Gratuity is payable in the following cases:
- Retirement at the age of 58 or above.
- Resignation after completing 5+ years of service.
- Death or disability (in which case, gratuity is paid to the nominee or legal heir).
- Termination due to ill health or accidents.
## Gratuity Calculation Formula
- Gratuity is calculated as:
- (Last Drawn Basic Salary + DA) × 15 × Number of Completed Years of Service / 26
## For example:
- If an employee’s last drawn basic salary + DA is ₹40,000
- And they have completed 10 years of service, then:
- Gratuity = (40,000 × 15 × 10) / 26 = ₹2,30,769 (approx.)
## Maximum Gratuity Limit
- As per current regulations, the maximum gratuity payable is ₹20 lakhs.
- Any amount beyond this is at the discretion of the company.
## Gratuity Payment Process
- Employees need to submit a written application to HR at least 30 days before retirement/resignation.
- In case of death or disability, the nominee/legal heir must apply for gratuity.
- Payment is processed within 30 days of the application.

chapters.title: Grievance Mechanism
chapters.text:
## Purpose
Bedmutha Industries is committed to providing a safe, respectful, and fair workplace. This grievance mechanism ensures that employees can raise concerns, complaints, or disputes in a structured and transparent manner without fear of retaliation.
## Scope
- This applies to all employees, including full-time, part-time, contract, and temporary staff at all levels of the organization.
- This mechanism is applicable to issues such as (but not limited to):
- Harassment (including sexual harassment)
- Discrimination based on gender, caste, religion, disability, age, etc.
- Unfair treatment or favoritism
- Health and safety concerns
- Bullying or verbal abuse
- Unlawful termination or suspension
- Violation of workplace rights
- Breach of company policy or ethics
- Retaliation or intimidation after raising a concern
## Principles
- Accessibility: All employees and stakeholders are informed about the grievance mechanism. Information is shared during onboarding, displayed on notice boards, and available in multiple languages (where needed) to ensure barrier-free access, especially for minority or underrepresented groups.
- Confidentiality: All grievances will be handled with utmost confidentiality.
- Fairness & Impartiality: Complaints will be reviewed fairly and objectively.
- Non-Retaliation: Employees will not face any discrimination, punishment, or retaliation for raising a grievance.
- Timeliness: Issues will be addressed promptly within a reasonable timeframe.
## Step 1: Informal Resolution
- Employees are encouraged to first discuss concerns with their immediate supervisor or manager to resolve the issue informally.
- If the issue is not resolved or if the employee is uncomfortable approaching the supervisor, they may proceed to Step 2.
## Step 2: Formal Complaint Submission
- The grievance should be submitted in writing using the Grievance Form (available from HR) or via email to the HR department.
- The complaint should include details such as:
- Date and time of the incident
- Nature of the grievance
- Persons involved
- Any supporting documents or evidence
## Step 3: Investigation & Resolution
- The HR department will acknowledge receipt of the complaint within 3 working days.
- An impartial investigation will be conducted, including interviews with the complainant, respondent, and any witnesses.
- A resolution will be provided within 15 working days. If additional time is required, the employee will be informed of the extended timeline and reason.
## Step 4: Escalation
- If the employee is dissatisfied with the resolution, they may escalate the grievance to senior management or the Grievance Redressal Committee.
- The final decision will be communicated within 10 working days of escalation.
## Reporting Channels
Employees or external stakeholders may report grievances through the following channels:
- Email to the HR Department: hr@bedmutha.com
- Grievance Box: Physical grievance drop-boxes are installed at main entrances of all factory units and corporate office premises.
- Direct Contact with HR Team: Call or visit the HR office during working hours. HR Contact Number: +91 253 238 2502 / 238 2023. & Corporate Office: A-32, STICE, Sinnar, Nashik, Maharashtra – 422113.

## External Resolution
If internal procedures do not resolve the concern satisfactorily, employees may seek legal or regulatory assistance as per applicable labor laws.
## Review & Monitoring
- All grievances and resolutions will be formally documented and reviewed annually to assess recurring patterns and ensure fairness.
- Continuous improvements will be made to enhance the grievance handling process.
- Data on grievances will be kept confidential and used solely for internal policy refinement.
## Assurance of Protection
- Those who file grievances will not be retaliated against or penalized.
- Investigations will be handled with strict confidentiality to protect all parties involved.
- Breaches of confidentiality or retaliation will be treated as serious misconduct.
